Name: Load Balancer Port
Description: Port players enter in the client's server login. Forward it.

Name: Shard Port
Description: Hangar and account service; the load balancer sends clients here. Forward it.

Name: Battle Server Ports
Description: Ports for the battle and open-space servers, one per running match. They only open while a match runs. Forward the whole range.

Name: Hub Port
Description: Internal: the server services connect to Hub on this port. Do not forward it.

Name: Hub Status Port
Description: Internal: Hub's status listener. Do not forward it.

Name: MongoDB Port
Description: Internal: the bundled MongoDB, bound to 127.0.0.1. Do not forward it.
